## Cause
`MigrationLoader.load_disk()` in `django/db/migrations/loader.py` rejected any migrations module lacking `__file__`:

```python
# Empty directories are namespaces.
if getattr(module, '__file__', None) is None:
    self.unmigrated_apps.add(app_config.label)
    continue
```

Since Python 3.3, a directory without `__init__.py` is an implicit namespace package — its `__file__` is `None`/absent (verified on this box: `__file__: None`, `__spec__.origin: None`), so the app was silently marked unmigrated and its migrations never loaded. The check is obsolete: discovery now uses `pkgutil.iter_modules(module.__path__)` (line 101), and `__path__` exists on namespace packages. The other `__file__` use, in `questioner.py`, already has a `__path__` fallback — no change needed there.
